label: Five epistemicide harm indicators
family: XIX · Aperture v3.2-alpha embedded kernels and epistemicide methodology

record.category: XIX · Aperture v3.2-alpha embedded kernels and epistemicide methodology
record.description: The original SignalRupture essays define access failure, custodial collapse, provenance disruption, algorithmic suppression and documentary harm. Aperture later operationalizes these classes; its six knowledge-survival capacities are a distinct extension. Indicator presence alone does not establish intent or a validated epistemicide diagnosis.
record.note: Direct theory-source intake supplies the conceptual definitions; Aperture operationalization and empirical validation retain their separate lineage and evidentiary burden.
